name: runtime-test-2bcb63c65d/runtime-error-v
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.runtime lists only sleep, onGracefulStop and StopHandler; ballerina/lang.error lists only message.

Subset restrictions > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions" lists error:message but not error:stackTrace, array:slice or string:startsWith.
Expressions: "Currently support nil-literal, boolean-literal, numeric-literal and string-literal only"; regexp templates are not in the supported expression list.
reason: The case essentially requires runtime:StackFrame and runtime:getStackTrace plus error:StackFrame and error.stackTrace(), all outside the explicit supported langlib lists. It asserts exact stack depth, callable names, runtime-library frames, filenames and line numbers, behavior not covered by the supported runtime operations. Additional unsupported operations are used to normalize and inspect those traces.
unsupported_constructs: ballerina/lang.regexp replace and regexp template expressions
test_design_notes: Expected frames include JVM-runtime-specific externGetStackTrace/getStackTrace entries and fixed runtime.bal line numbers 121 and 111; these assertions exceed the supported runtime surface.
io:println is output instrumentation and is not the basis of classification.
